pull_request.title: Calorimeter: fill HCAL sector edges and validate 50 GeV pion response
pull_request.head: codex/hcal-edge-coverage
pull_request.body:
Whole common carriers left broad inactive bands along HCAL barrel sector edges. DES-046 adds newly manufactured narrow cassettes with smaller scintillator cores and complete PCB/SiPM/reflector/electronics/cooling backing, reducing the inactive tangent strip to about 7.05 mm per side at the core plane. A 2 mm guide replaces the 20 mm rail and steel extends to that guide. The global envelopes,60 × 30 mm nominal steel depth and endcaps are unchanged.

The requested HCAL-only pi-minus 50 GeV study is complete, with no ECAL, tracker or field. It retains all zeros/tails and uses the original 10000 angular primary vectors. Raw inclusive SD/mean changes **24.03%→17.24%**, and folded-phi edge bins change approximately **44%→17%**. The eta/phi comparison retains the repeated outer windows and matched-primary bootstrap covariance.

![Angular response comparison](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/hcal-edge-coverage/docs/validation/hcal50-edge/angular-figures/raw-energy-resolution-comparison.png?raw=true)

A geometry-only scan selected eta = 0, phi = −0.75° before showers. An independent 2000-event calibration froze fs=0.01279050527 before 10000 fixed validation events. The dedicated figure reports rawSD **0.061627GeV**, rawSD/Etrue **0.123254%**, and sampling-corrected relativeSD **9.636377%** (95%two-sample interval9.228–10.097%). Raw/corrected SD divided by the measured mean is **9.642584%**; scalar scaling leaves it unchanged. The held-out corrected mean is49.967811GeV. This is an effective direction/energy-specific pion response calibration, not an intrinsic material-only sampling fraction.

![Fixed barrel response](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/hcal-edge-coverage/docs/validation/hcal50-edge/fixed-figures/fixed-direction-response.png?raw=true)

Validation:30 tests pass; both C++ libraries build; all 102 native sensitive solids, 379344 contexts, 23157216 logical channels and 15 material totals validate; zero overlaps at 10 nm; native finite rays confirm the prospectively chosen direction; serial/12-worker 24-event saved cells match exactly. All 22000 production/calibration primaries and every saved hit pass ID/physical-centre/step→native→saved closure checks. Seven published PNGs replay byte-identically in the recorded environment. Separate PhysVal reviews independently reproduced the angular and fixed statistics/uncertainties with no blocking finding. Statistical producers are frozen at7059bf6c; later rendering-only edits have explicit AST/source separation. Full ROOT/events/candidates remain local and ignored; compact summaries, covariance, PNG/PDF/SVG, source hashes and reproduction recipes are included.

DRAFT/PROTOTYPE: the exact mechanical seam remains. Structural support, connector pinout and external services are unqualified; no former rail load-path qualification transfers. Added hardware/material raises represented mass by 131.5 t and nominal local heat by 22.52%. The maintained tracker+ECAL detector is unchanged; this grants no engineering sign-off or detector acceptance.

Task TASK-HCAL-EDGE-COVERAGE, governing DES-046 with DES-045/036/037 context. Stacked on PR156 to retain the implemented HCAL/drawing source. Draft publication follows the standing AGENTS.md instruction; no ready-for-review action or merge.

events.text:
The old retained overview used the1495.9mm HCAL context and is preserved unchanged. The new named input uses barrel apothems3130/5720mm, halfz6260mm, endcap apothems300/5710mm and |z|6760–9350mm. The physical depth is60×(30mmsteel+12mmcarrier+1mmallowance)+10mmcover=2590mm. DES046 smaller edge modules and2mmguides do not change global r–z bounds; their7.047825mm per-side inactive core-plane strip is stated in the caption.

The renderer first verifies every source hash in the HCAL geometry receipt frozen at7059bf6c and every retained tracker source. It rebuilds the current selected ECAL barrel/endcap envelopes, including local services, and checks them against the prior snapshot. Historical ECAL source hashes are explicitly retained as historical provenance; a separate current source map includes changed service/optional-prototype implementations and the ECAL selector. This is a fact about checked project source, not an additional design choice. No geometry/material/response source is changed.

HCAL striping depicts sampling organization, not continuous sensitive planes. Individual module/sector gaps and tracker passive services are unresolved at this scale. Solenoid hatching, cold-mass allocation and assembly reservation remain conditional. Polygon radii are face apothems, with the maximum barrel corner radius stated separately. FCAL/muons are omitted pending integration. No combined native detector, installed field, structural/service qualification or detector acceptance is inferred.
